events.title: Mob Makers Meet
events.description: A community meetup and artist talk for First Nations people working in the arts, offering a space for networking, discussion, and connecting with creative peers.

events.title: Pint of Science Festival
events.description: An evening of engaging science talks and discussions, bringing researchers to local pubs and cafes to share stories about brains, bodies, and health with a general audience.

events.title: 19-Twenty & Greg Nunan and The General Jacksons Live
events.description: An evening of live music featuring 19-Twenty and Greg Nunan and The General Jacksons, offering an energetic performance in a local pub setting.

events.title: The Man from Snowy River in concert live to film with Southern Cross Symphony
events.description: Experience a unique screening of 'The Man from Snowy River' with its iconic score performed live by the Southern Cross Symphony, blending cinematic art with live orchestral music.

events.title: Saturday Board Games Night
events.description: A weekly board games night hosted by the Gold Coast Board Games Club, offering a casual and friendly environment to play a variety of games and connect with other enthusiasts.
